sentences.ko: 설마 공룡 옷 입고 갈 생각은 아니지?
sentences.text: Please tell me you're not going to dress up like a dinosaur.

alts.text: Don't tell me you're dressing up as a dinosaur.
I hope you are not planning to dress up as a dinosaur.

sentences.note: **Please tell me you're not** 은 상대가 하려는 일이 믿기지 않을 때 "제발 아니라고 해" 하며 앞에 붙이는 말이다. 같은 자리에 **Don't tell me** 도 그대로 쓸 수 있다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 난 그냥 빠질래. 지난번에 스키 타러 갔을 때 리프트에서 못 내리겠더라고.
sentences.text: I'm going to stay cuz the last time I went skiing, I was too afraid to jump off the chairlift.

alts.text: You guys go ahead — last time I went skiing I was too scared to get off the lift.
I would rather stay behind, because the last time I went skiing, I was too afraid to get off the chairlift.

sentences.note: **too afraid to** 는 무서워서 결국 못 했다고 털어놓을 때 쓴다. **the last time I** 는 '지난번에 ~했을 때'로, 안 하겠다는 이유를 지난 경험 하나로 대는 자리에 자주 온다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.text: Okay, I better just say what it is I'm going to say.

alts.text: Fine, let me just get it out.
Let me simply say what I came here to say.

sentences.note: **I better just** 는 뜸 들이다가 마음먹고 꺼낼 때 쓰는 말이다. 담아 둔 말을 꺼낸다는 뜻으로 **get it out** 도 같은 자리에서 쓴다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 내가 저번에 그건 너 혼자 알아서 하라고 했잖아?
sentences.text: You know when I said that I want you to deal with this relationship stuff all on your own?

alts.text: Remember I told you to handle all this relationship stuff yourself?
Do you recall my saying that you should handle these relationship matters by yourself?

sentences.note: **You know when I said** 는 전에 한 말을 다시 꺼내며 뒤집거나 조건을 붙이려 할 때 쓰는 시작말이다. 뒤에는 대개 "그거 취소" 같은 말이 온다. **on your own** 은 '혼자 힘으로'.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 남의 카드를 훔칠 정도면 이미 조심할 마음 같은 건 없는 거 아니야?
sentences.text: I think when somebody steals your credit card, they've kind of already thrown caution to the wind.

alts.text: Anyone who'd steal your card has already stopped playing it safe.
Someone who steals a credit card has already abandoned all caution.

sentences.note: **thrown caution to the wind** 은 조심성을 다 내던지고 겁 없이 구는 것을 말한다. 반대로 몸 사리는 쪽은 **playing it safe** 라고 한다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends
